description: Strings() keys reachable from gen1recomp's game3 (Ruby/Sapphire) runtime, generated by pipeline/gen3/engine_scope.py: literal Strings()/Strings.source() callsites under src/*/game3, tables and lists the runtime passes to Strings() through a variable, and the ROM's move and ability descriptions, Pokédex entries and contest texts.  Language-neutral values (numbers, multipliers, refresh rates) are left out.  A qid names the Ruby/Sapphire cart's own row for the key; runtime values in that row fill the key's directives, renumbered when the translation orders them differently.  Keys without a qid are port-added or have no clean corpus row, and are covered by overrides/<language>/rse/engine.json or by the overrides of the game3 families it shares the runtime with (overrides/<language>/rse/emerald_engine.json, overrides/<language>/frlg/engine.json).
